patch_list: Makes dark-theme page, app navigation and system bars pure black (AMOLED) while keeping elevated cards, sheets and controls gray so their boundaries remain visible.
Hides Avito offers from blacklisted adverts or sellers and adds a blacklist manager (import/export compatible with the Ave Blacklist extension).
Disables Avito first-party clickstream analytics and Avito's direct Adjust telemetry wrapper.
Prevents Avito's force-update screen opener from launching update screens. Toggleable in Настройки Morphe.
Adds a maximum seller review count to Avito search filters and hides or dims offers from sellers above that limit.
Adds a "Настройки Morphe" entry to Avito's settings that hosts the configuration for the other Morphe patches.
Disables Avito ads by removing ad SDK entry points and short-circuiting commercial banner loading.

Optional interface tweaks, each toggleable in Настройки Morphe: single-row home categories, hide the "Подписки" tab in Избранное, hide installments (Рассрочка) and the "Спросите у продавца" block on offers, expand descriptions by default (…
